protocol: Run deterministic baseline and candidate model on identical frozen questions and source packets.
Record source_packet_sha256, prompt_version, model_version, and configuration for each case.
Use at least two independent reviewers, blinded to system identity where practical.
Each reviewer must score both baseline and candidate answers independently using all five rubric dimensions.
Store scores under reviewer_scores[reviewer_id].baseline_scores and reviewer_scores[reviewer_id].candidate_scores; do not submit only pooled scores.
Keep case IDs unique and never mix different source packets within a pair.
The evaluator averages paired reviewer deltas within each case, then bootstraps cases as the independent resampling unit.
Interpret paired ordinal-score differences descriptively; do not claim scientific superiority from a small or biased sample.
